title: Chocolate Chip Vanilla
description: Texture pack that tweaks and improves many of the Vanilla Minecraft Textures.
body: This pack updates textures of many blocks and mobs to give them a brand new vibe. Tired of Creepers having the same old texture? You dream of Happy Ghasts looking even cuter? You want bricks and command blocks to finally be symmetrical? If so, then this pack is for you!
